content:
Best Buy has updated its massive 60th anniversary sale with new deals added – we still have AirPods Pro 3 for 25% off, AirPods Max 2 for $120 off, and AirTag 2 at an all-time low. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is also featuring the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $500 off at Amazon, Anker's new SmartTrack Find My wallet card down to $25 (a new low), and Mint Mobile's unprecedented 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plan for just $15/month. Read on for all the details.

Best Buy updates its massive 60th anniversary sale with new deals: TVs starting from $110, electronics up to 50% off, major appliances $1,000 off, and more

AirPods deals drop further, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off and more

After a steady summer of Apple AirPods discounts on its latest lineup, prices have dropped further across nearly every model. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 is now 25% off and at one of its best prices ever, while the AirPods 4 with ANC have dropped to their lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 saw an extra $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (was $129)

Rare deal: M4 Mac mini drops $150 at official Apple Refurbished Store today

Update: This deal has already sold out and we'll be keeping an eye on restocks.

AirPods Pro 3, the new AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pro models, and more all see notable discounts, but the new M4 Mac mini has been hard to come by. Retailers like Amazon and Best Buy used to offer deals frequently, but now it's nearly impossible to find. We've now spotted an extremely rare opportunity to score a 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini for $150 off through the official Apple Refurbished Store.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 (shipping included).

New all-time low: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees massive $500 price drop at Amazon

This week, timed to a special 1-day Apple event, brand new M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations have seen significant $400 price drops. However, we particularly want to highlight one — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $500 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now shipping the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in SSD for $2,699.

This configuration, originally priced at $3,199, features an upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (the one that's currently $400 off has a 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU). Although this model just saw a price increase, it's still $100 cheaper than the older, lower MSRP.

Both options are solid depending on your performance needs — at the current $400 and $500 off prices, the CPU/GPU upgrade would typically cost an extra $200, but with today's deals, it's just $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (was $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (was $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We estimate this $500 discount won't last long, but we're not sure if it will hold through Sunday's big sale event.

Apple's new AirTag 2 hits an all-time low this week at Amazon, but there's still a way to get one for just $20

Apple deals keep coming this week: AirPods Pro 3 are still 25% off, the new AirPods Max 2 are $120 off, which are among the best prices we've seen. Beyond specific M5 Pro MacBook Pro models being $500 off, some of the more notable discounts also fall on its new AirTag 2 trackers, with both single and 4-packs returning to all-time lows — but you can also still grab one of them for just $20 right now.

Amazon has now dropped the price of both the AirTag 2 single pack and 4-pack simultaneously to their lowest prices since launch earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (was $99)

That works out to $22.25 per tracker on the 4-pack, and the single AirTag 2 has also returned to its Prime Day all-time low of $24.

It's not much cheaper, but worth noting that Best Buy is also listing the AirTag 2 single pack as "Premium" open-box for what we've tracked as the lowest price — you can grab one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 "Premium" open-box $20 (was $29 new) | Best Buy

While that's only $4 cheaper than Amazon's new condition, I'd personally opt for this route, but it is indeed the cheaper option. Best Buy is also offering the same deal on new units, so if you're already shopping their ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it's worth checking out their selection.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week deals drop $100, Best Buy open-box from $254

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card (iOS or Android supported) drops to Amazon all-time low of $25

Anker recently launched its new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card — its first product that supports both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and it's now dropped to a new all-time low of $25 with free shipping for Prime members at Amazon.

Anker's official EufyHome store on Amazon is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (iOS or Android supported) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This product only landed on Amazon last month at $35, then dropped $5 by the end of that month, and is now seeing its first significant discount, hitting an Amazon all-time low.

At this price, you're looking at nearly 30% off, on par with some of the better wallet tracker card deals this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards — the basic version starts at $35, and the Pro model with 16-month battery life goes up to $45 before needing a charge — but regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should keep one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without one.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, and is compatible with both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub. It's only 1.7mm thick, with an 80dB ring volume for easy tracking nearby — and of course, it can be loaded directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps to see its location on the map.

Mint Mobile now offering unprecedented 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plan for just $15/month

Mint Mobile is now offering unprecedented deals on unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. Although this carrier offers good value most of the time, it's now offering an Unlimited 12-month plan for just $15/month — that's 50% off, or $180 for a full year of unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you don't plan to switch your primary service right now, this price is low enough to consider as a backup line or for an iPad.

While their 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best value is the 5G • 4G LTE Plan: Unlimited/MO 12 months for just $15/month.

  • Unlimited 12-month Mint Mobile plan $15/month (50% off)

According to the terms and conditions, you'll need to prepay $180 for the 12-month plan (equivalent to $15/month), but for those looking to switch to a new carrier at a discount or add a second line for another device/as a backup, this is truly an amazing deal.

You can "activate service immediately (if your phone is eSIM compatible)" for various Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. If needed, you can keep your existing number and bring your own unlocked phone to use this service.

Head over to the deal page for more details.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of its late-summer sale event, Amazon is covering various Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home devices, and is now also offering the new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro at its all-time low price, while bringing the wired version back to its Prime Day all-time low, also close to 30% off.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (was $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (was $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker MagSafe power bank this week from $36 with free shipping (lots of colors to choose from)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is a top pick, now 35% off (matches all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the nicest MagSafe stands I've seen, $27 (was $35)
  • Twelve South's all-purpose braided PowerCord USB-C charger from $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5ft cable, $36 today
  • Woot's massive PC sale kicks off: gaming desktops, monitors, fans, and more up to 75% off, deals from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with display features power-loss protection, today just $29
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub plunges to $52 all-time low (57% off)
  • Twelve South Find My-equipped USB-C wall charger hits Amazon all-time low, under $37
  • Wow! These leather Apple Watch bands Prime shipped for just $6 (75% off)

Amazon now offering $120 off AirPods Max 2 in all five colors (one of the all-time lows)

This week's massive 60th anniversary sale is featuring one of the all-time low prices for the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off across all five colors.

Amazon is now shipping the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429.

Compared to the previous generation at the same $549 price, you can reliably save $120, which is the lowest price we've found for a new unit from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy is indeed listing the Midnight black version at $403.99 with free shipping in "Premium" open-box condition, which is indeed cheaper, but perhaps not cheap enough to pass up a new unit.

Apple has launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, unlike the previous generation which only got new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, it won't be updating its over-ear options at next month's new product announcement, so this week's $120 discount might be the newest, strongest version of Apple's over-ear headphones for some time to come.

The only other sale that previously offered it at a lower price was earlier this year's Prime Day, when it was $30 cheaper than this current deal — but that 4-day sale event also had very limited and unstable stock.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro devices drop $220 today (matches Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my top choice for iPhone deals, Apple isn't yet selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there, which looks to be after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed stock has now returned to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off on new models.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed devices have consistently been the best option for unlocked iPhone 17 Pro deals. Beyond saving a few hundred dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and "greater than 90% original battery life" — non-"Premium" Renewed and refurbished stock on Amazon only offers a 90-day warranty and won't have the same battery life guarantee.

You can now find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models for up to $220 off — 512GB is $20 cheaper than we last mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (was $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store featured deals, you can grab iPhone 16 models with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699, and the 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — which is $330 cheaper than a comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than a 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger holds at $26 low, but this bundle is just $4 more with a USB-C cable included

Take-Two officially files subpoena in federal court to track down GTA VI leaker
